Great food!
Nov 2025 • Couples
Saw this place on a random travellers post when we were trying to find places to eat in Da Nang. Randomly selected this place which was a 10min walk from our hotel. It's down a hidden street but boy were we happy to experience the great food here. I would have never known if we relied on ourselves to choose lol The food was so delicious, the service was quick and we didn't have to wait long at all for our food. My husband and I tried the fried spring rolls, the shrimp paper rolls, the noodles with chicken and vegetables and the chicken and curry with rice. Allllll great local food which was exactly what we were after! But we totally forgot to try the scallops! Next time!

Wonderful local cafe in Danang- highly recommended 👌😁
Mar 2025 • Couples

Jenny’s service is excellent, friendly and helpful and great English and the food is always delicious and fresh. We now regularly go there for breakfast or lunch and plan to do dinners well sometime fabulous thank you. The prices very good and we love the fresh carrot ginger and apple juice and Vietnamese coffee which is always excellent or ginger tea. We often encourage our friends to go there as well now and plan to take our family when they come to visit. Would highly recommend this cafe as your local regular.👌😁🌸
